_about: Reviewed changes to the capital from GeoNames (feature code PPLC of the region's main country code). null: the card shows no capital. 'note' adds a remark. 'geonameId', or 'name' with 'at' as [longitude, latitude], sets another place.

BOL.note: La Paz is the seat of government.

CHE.note: The constitution names no capital. Bern is the federal city.

CHL.note: The National Congress meets in Valparaíso.

CIV.note: Most government offices are in Abidjan.

GNQ.note: Ciudad de la Paz became the capital in January 2026. The government is moving there from Malabo.

IND.note: New Delhi lies in the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

ISR.note: Many countries do not recognize Jerusalem as the capital. Most embassies are in Tel Aviv.

LKA.note: Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte is the legislative capital.

MNE.note: Cetinje has the title of Old Royal Capital.

MSR.note: Plymouth has been empty since the 1997 eruption. The government sits in Brades.

NLD.note: The government sits in The Hague.

NRU.note: Nauru has no official capital. The government sits in Yaren.

PSE.name: East Jerusalem
PSE.note: Palestine proclaims East Jerusalem as its capital. The government sits in Ramallah.

SWZ.note: Lobamba is the royal and legislative capital.

ZAF.note: Cape Town is the legislative capital. Bloemfontein is the judicial capital.
